description: This Java class defines a Fragment for Bluetooth chat functionality in an Android app, managing Bluetooth connections, messaging UI, and communication handling.

classes.name: BluetoothChatFragment
classes.description: A Fragment that manages Bluetooth chat, including connection setup, message exchange, and UI updates.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes Bluetooth adapter and checks for Bluetooth support.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Checks Bluetooth state and initiates chat setup.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Stops Bluetooth chat service if active.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Starts Bluetooth service if not already started.

methods.name: setupChat
methods.description: Sets up chat UI and Bluetooth service.

methods.name: sendMessage
methods.description: Sends a message over Bluetooth if connected.

methods.name: mWriteListener
methods.description: Handles return key press to send message.

methods.name: setStatus
methods.description: Updates action bar subtitle with connection status.

methods.name: mHandler
methods.description: Handles messages from BluetoothChatService for UI updates.

methods.name: onActivityResult
methods.description: Handles results from Bluetooth enable and device selection activities.

methods.name: connectDevice
methods.description: Connects to a Bluetooth device using data from intent.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selections for device connection and discoverability.
